profile.summary: A small Oakland-based consulting company that provides leadership coaching and development services. It works with school leaders and community members on building more equitable schools and communities, including community-led planning processes and education research support.

sources.title: Roda Leadership Development LLC Oakland, CA - filing information

review.notes: The California LLC Roda Leadership Development LLC (entity 202136110410, active, Oakland) matches the agenda name and Oakland location. Its website describes school leadership coaching, equity-focused school redesign and community-led processes, which fits OUSD's school-based services agreements. The summary is neutral and consistent with the sources; the word 'small' is an inference, but a minor one. Personal email and the residential registered address were correctly omitted. I could not retrieve Legistar file 24-3120 independently.
